sampling.method: OAI xoai 를 오프셋 0·12000·…·120000 으로 11번 점프해 1,100건 표집틀을 만들고(type=book 889건), 영어 선언 + 다운로드 URL 보유 + 연도 보유인 496권을 모집단으로 삼았다. 고정 시드(mulberry32, seed=20260924)로 섞은 뒤 주제 3층(인문7·사회7·과학6) · 연도 4구간 · 한 출판사 최대 2권 제약으로 20권을 뽑았다.
sampling.bias: 모집단을 영어·다운로드가능으로 좁혔으므로 표본 20권의 라이선스 분포는 DOAB 전체보다 CC BY 쪽으로 치우친다. 치우치지 않은 값은 표집틀 889권 쪽(g0.byLicense_frame)을 쓸 것.

attempts.before: Beautiful arts and sciences, which by means of a universally communicable pleasure and an elegance and refinement make human beings, if not morally better, at least better mannered for society, very much reduce the tyranny of sensible tendencies [Tyrannei des Sinnenhanges], and prepare humans for a sovereignty [Herrschaft] in which reason alone shall have power [in welcher die Vernunft allein Gewalt haben soll]. (KU §83 5:433–34; CPJ 301). Much of the literary and aesthetic discourse after Kant will attack his philosophical commitment to moral teleology, and, with it, fundamental tenets of Kant's theory. As they chip away at the philosophical system that enabled Kant to conceive of natural, aesthetic, and moral-political life as elements of a single, if speculative, directed process, authors from Kleist to Musil will flesh out in great detail the dynamics within, and conflicts between, these diverse forms of life. Yet insofar as it was Kant's new vision of mind and nature that made visible these forms as forms of life in the first place, Kant's Critique of the Power of Judgment can be said to open up the conceptual horizon that allowed much of the nineteenth-and twentieth-century German aesthetic and philosophical discourse on life to go beyond it.
attempts.after: The arts and sciences offer a pleasure that anyone can share, and in doing so they refine manners even when they do not make people morally better. That refinement matters, because it loosens the grip of appetite and prepares people for a condition in which reason alone holds authority. Later writers attacked this picture. They doubted that nature moved toward any moral purpose at all, and once that assumption fell, the system resting on it fell too. What the system had held together was a single idea: that biological life, artistic life and political life were stages of one directed process. The novelists and dramatists who followed spent their careers tracing how these ways of living actually strain against one another. Yet the quarrel was possible only because the earlier account had named them in the first place. A framework can open the ground on which its own successors stand.

attempts.before: 5.2.3 "Housing [...] Is the Foundation of the Family" "Financial autonomy" (duli shenghuo) from parents, is a central aspect in the respondents' definitions of adulthood. According to Qian, being an adult means no longer depending on financial aid from parents to live (born in 1982, urban, Jilin hukou, PhD). This aspiration is more present in the discourse of male respondents. They feel an obligation, once adult, to be the main provider for their family. In this sense, financial autonomy from parents is less about proving their individualism than it is about them acting as breadwinners and no longer being a burden on their parents. It is about moving from a logic of assistance to a logic of reciprocity based on filial ties. Once schooling is finished, it is up to young people to support themselves financially, or even to help their parents financially. The respondents' comments denote a deep structuring of trajectories by a strong valorization of employment, especially in male paths, with employment being the main vector of financial autonomy.
attempts.after: For many young adults, becoming grown up means no longer needing money from one's parents. One man interviewed for the study put it simply: an adult is someone who does not depend on family support to live. The idea came up far more often among the men than among the women. Once they considered themselves adult, the men felt bound to become the household's main earner. What they described was not really a claim to independence for its own sake. It was a wish to stop being a cost to their parents and to begin repaying them, a shift from receiving help to returning it, still inside the bonds of family duty. When schooling ends, the obligation reverses: young people are expected to support themselves, and often to support their parents as well. In their accounts, steady work is what makes that reversal possible, and it shapes the men's paths most of all.

attempts.before: with. There are decades of research work in literature to remove these artefacts [15, 16]. A range of methods have been proposed to remove the artefacts, starts with a statistical with interpolation method [17] and regression method [18]. The most commonly used approaches are based on Blind Source Separation (BSS) using Independent Component Analysis (ICA) [19, 20]. ICA based approach have been widely explored with statistical measures [21–24], and variant of ICA as FastICA, InfoMax, and Extended InfoMax [25–27]. Wavelet-based approaches are well suited for time-localised short events, as opposed to ICA. This property has been exploited to remove artefacts from single-channel EEG. In contrast to a single channel, wavelet has also been used for multi-channel EEG [28] and in combination with ICA [29–34], in which identified artifactual component is cleaned with wavelet rather than removed. attempts.after: Recordings of brain activity are never clean. Muscle movement, eye blinks and stray electrical interference all leave marks on the signal, and researchers have spent decades trying to strip them out. The earliest attempts simply filled in the damaged stretches by estimating what should have been there. Later work treated the recording as a mixture of separate sources and tried to pull those sources apart, and that family of methods became the standard choice. It carries one cost: it needs many channels recording at the same time, and it needs a trained eye to decide which of the separated parts is noise. A different approach looks instead at how the signal changes shape from moment to moment. Because it catches brief, sharply placed events well, it can clean a single channel on its own, and rather than throwing a suspect part away it can repair it.

originalSecurable_sample20.note: R0·R1 만 "원문 확보"다. 표본 20권 중 9권(45%) — 전부 CC BY(R1), PD·CC0(R0)은 0권이다. 치우치지 않은 값은 표집틀 889권 기준 34.9%.

verdict.yieldNote: 창별 기계 절단 수는 권당 수능짧은 780 · 수능장문 195 로 크지만, **가중치가 붙는 슬롯(B·C)의 기대 산출은 0 이다.** A 슬롯은 가중치 0 이라 곱하면 0 이고, 게다가 G3 대조에서 A 의 문체 기준(고유명사 0 · 대조표지 65~87%)에도 못 미친다. 그래서 A 칸 산출도 "그대로 쓸 수 있는 편수"로는 세지 않았다.
verdict.recommendation: 수확하지 않는다. 대조군으로서의 목적은 달성했다 — "과잉인 A 칸이 정말 과잉인가"에 대한 답은 "과잉일 뿐 아니라 이 원천은 그 칸의 문체 기준에도 못 미친다" 였다. 재저작 입력으로만 쓸 수 있고, 그것은 DOAB 이 아니어도 되는 일이다(수정량 중앙 78.6% = 논지만 가져오는 것).
verdict.ifEverHarvested: 그래도 돌린다면: (1) 라이선스는 OAI `xoai` 의 rightsuri 로만 읽고, (2) 연도 + 출판사 정책(ANU 2018 경계 같은 것)을 교차 확인하고, (3) 판권장을 실제로 읽어 메타데이터와 대 보고(14권 중 4권 불일치), (4) 본문은 OAPEN REST 의 ORIGINAL PDF + pdftotext 로 받고 TEXT 번들은 쓰지 않는다.

limits: 표집틀이 1,100건(그중 book 889건)이다. DOAB 전체는 OAI completeListSize 128,187(출판사·후원기관 레코드 포함). 오프셋 11곳을 고르게 점프했지만 **전수가 아니다** — 라이선스 분포 34.9% 는 이 표집틀의 값이다.
`type=book` 889건 기준으로 셌다. chapter 89건은 뺐다. chapter 를 포함하면 분포가 달라질 수 있는데 재지 않았다.
본문은 20권 중 14권만 받았다. 못 받은 6권(Frontiers 2 · MDPI 2 · KIT 1 · Manchester 1)의 G2·G3 은 **측정하지 않았고 추정하지도 않았다.** 이들이 OA 학술서의 큰 부분(MDPI·Frontiers 는 표집틀 영어책 상위 2위 출판사)이라 G3 중앙값이 그쪽으로 치우쳤는지 모른다.
판권장 대조는 본문을 받은 14권에만 했다. "메타 vs 본문 불일치 4/14" 를 20권·889권으로 확대하지 않았다.
「메타데이터는 CC, 판권장은 ARR」이 법적으로 무엇을 뜻하는지는 재지 않았다. OA 판과 인쇄판의 권리가 갈리는 경우일 수 있다 — criteria.md 대로 **법률 판단은 사용자 소관**으로 남긴다. 여기서는 "책 자신이 그렇게 말한다"는 사실만 기록했다.
어휘 대역(NGSL+NAWL 밖 비율)은 재지 않았다. G2 에서 off-list 낱말을 손으로 풀어 보기만 했다.
갈래 판정(설명 13 · 논증 7)은 주제 분류와 표지 비율에 기댄 것으로 경계가 단정적이지 않다. 문단 전수를 눈으로 보지는 않았다.
G2 는 3권 3문단이다(과제 지시대로). criteria.md 의 "원천마다 문단 3개"보다 얕다 — 수정량 중앙 78.6% 는 표본 3개의 중앙값이다.
고유명사 밀도는 문중 대문자 정규식의 대리 지표다. 독일어 명사 대문자(b02·b17 같은 독일 주제 책)를 고유명사로 셌을 수 있다.
Cloudflare 가 막은 경로를 우회하지 않았다. 브라우저 UA 위장을 썼다면 6권 중 몇 권을 더 받았을지는 모른다.
